---
title: "Trap: citations with nothing to cite them from"
mdbrand:
  brand: none
  style: note
---

No bibliography and no references, so pandoc prints these as written and exits
0: the argument rests on Knuth [@knuth1984, p. 3], as the diagram shows
[@fig:arq]. A bare handle such as @charlie is how people write a name in chat,
and must not be read as a citation.
